# PCBDukaan

> PCBDukaan (pcbdukaan.com) is an Indian online store for industrial electronics and a component-level industrial PCB repair service. It supplies factories, OEMs, panel builders and maintenance engineers across India with industrial control boards, SMPS and power supplies, VFD and motor-drive boards, PLC and I/O modules, load cells and weighing indicators, industrial sensors, relays and power components, HMIs, communication modules and test & repair tools. Prices are shown excluding 18% GST; GST invoices (with the buyer's company GSTIN) and cash on delivery are available across India.

## PCB repair
- [PCB repair service](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair): upload board photos, free quote usually within 1–2 working days, courier to and from anywhere in India
- [VFD / AC drive repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/vfd-drive-repair)
- [SMPS repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/smps-repair)

- [PLC repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/plc-repair)

- Brand repair pages, e.g. [Yaskawa VFD repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/vfd-drive-repair/yaskawa), [Delta servo drive repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/servo-drive-repair/delta), [Siemens PLC repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/plc-repair/siemens), [Weintek HMI repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/hmi-repair/weintek), [Mean Well SMPS repair](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair/smps-repair/mean-well)
- [PCB repair course](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-repair-course): hands-on training in component-level industrial PCB repair

## Guides & learning
- [Inverter, VFD & servo error codes](https://pcbdukaan.com/fault-codes): 251 codes, each on its own page (meaning, causes, checks) for Delta, Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, Siemens, ABB, Schneider, Danfoss, INVT, Fuji, Hitachi, Allen-Bradley PowerFlex, Vacon, Toshiba, LS, Lenze drives and Delta ASDA, Yaskawa Sigma, Mitsubishi MELSERVO, Panasonic MINAS servos – e.g. [Danfoss Alarm 14 earth fault](https://pcbdukaan.com/fault-codes/danfoss/alarm-14)
- [Repair guides](https://pcbdukaan.com/repair-guides): step-by-step checks such as testing IGBT modules and VFD capacitors
- [Learn PCB design](https://pcbdukaan.com/pcb-design): 12 free lessons – PCB basics, schematic and footprints, placement, trace width for current, creepage for 230 V mains, grounding/EMI, SMPS layout, thermal design, Gerber files, KiCad/EasyEDA/Altium, common mistakes
- [Areas served](https://pcbdukaan.com/locations): every Indian state and major industrial area
